10.0.10.11 VLAN 10, Year 1, completed

The network of a coworking space

Design and justify the full infrastructure of a 20-seat coworking space: hardware, addressing plan, services and open source software choices.

Context
SAÉ 2.03
Team
4 people
My role
Architecture, addressing, choice of services
Tools
Ubuntu, VMs, Apache, MariaDB, Postfix
Status
Completed

What I did

  • A network split into two zones, clients and servers, joined by a core switch. Internet access through a TP-Link ER605 router handling DHCP, NAT and firewalling.
  • The 192.168.1.0/24 addressing plan: static addresses for servers and workstations, DHCP for visitors on Wi-Fi.
  • Four virtualised servers on Ubuntu: web, database, mail, backup.
  • Three options compared for each service: MariaDB 11 chosen over MySQL 8.0 and PostgreSQL 16, Apache 2.4 over Nginx and Caddy, Postfix and Dovecot over Zimbra.

The security angle

HTTPS rather than HTTP, SFTP rather than FTP, one service per virtual machine: if the web server is compromised, the database stays protected. This is the project that brought me closest to the job I want.
